question_text: Was the Starbucks Mobile Order & Pay outage a cyberattack?
answer_text: Not established. Starbucks said only that there was 'an issue' and gave no cause. No source reports an attack or a claim of one, but nothing has ruled one out.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A Starbucks statement of the cause, or an independent security finding.

question_text: Is the Starbucks outage connected to this week's other outages?
answer_text: Not established. Officials say they found no evidence the week's outages were connected, and IBTimes Australia sees no sign of a link to Starbucks. That is second-hand and no cause has been published.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: Starbucks or an independent investigation naming the cause and any link to the other incidents.

question_text: Were customers charged for Starbucks orders that never went through?
answer_text: Unverified. Some customers say money left their balance without an order, but the accounts are unsigned tracker comments. Starbucks said refunds were temporarily unavailable.
label: Unverified
what_would_settle_it: A Starbucks statement on charges and refunds, or reporting that checks customer receipts.

question_text: Is the Starbucks app working again?
answer_text: Reported yes. The tracker shows reports back to their usual level by about 3 PM ET. Starbucks has not said service is fully restored.
label: Reported
what_would_settle_it: A Starbucks statement that service is restored.
